product_overview: The POS Native Android backend integration layer connects cashiers to Supabase and Next.js services for order management, online order sync, kiosk control, and gate approval. It is responsible for reliable authenticated API communication, data retrieval, status updates, and real-time synchronization.
core_goals: Authenticate and securely access all required backend services
Fetch and update POS order data with correct item and menu details
Provide revenue summary and promo retrieval for outlet operations
Maintain real-time synchronization with online orders via Supabase WebSocket
Support gate bypass approval and kiosk account/QR management

features.name: POS Database API
features.description: Provides authenticated REST and RPC access to POS Supabase data for orders, promos, and revenue summaries.
user_flows: GET /rest/v1/orders?select=*,order_items(*,menu_item:menu_items(id,name)) with a valid Bearer token -> Receive 200 with orders and nested order item/menu item details -> Display order list for the outlet
GET /rest/v1/orders?select=*,order_items(*,menu_item:menu_items(id,name)) with an invalid or missing token -> Receive 401 or 403 error -> Show authentication failure and stop order loading

PATCH /rest/v1/orders with a valid Bearer token and an order status update payload -> Receive 204 No Content or updated order representation -> Confirm order status changed from pending to preparing or completed
PATCH /rest/v1/orders with an invalid payload or unauthorized token -> Receive 400, 401, or 403 error -> Preserve current order state and surface an update failure message
POST /rest/v1/rpc/pos_revenue_summary_guarded with a valid Bearer token and outlet parameters -> Receive 200 with aggregated revenue summary -> Render outlet revenue totals and summary metrics
POST /rest/v1/rpc/pos_revenue_summary_guarded with missing outlet context or expired token -> Receive 400 or 401/403 error -> Block summary display and return an error state
GET /rest/v1/promos?select=* with a valid Bearer token -> Receive 200 with active promos -> Show currently valid promotions
GET /rest/v1/promos?select=* with invalid authorization -> Receive 401 or 403 error -> Keep promos list empty and display retry guidance

features.name: Online Orders API Sync
features.description: Maintains real-time synchronization with the separate Online Order Supabase project so newly placed website orders appear in the POS system.
user_flows: WS /realtime/v1/websocket with a valid authenticated Supabase connection -> Receive successful WebSocket connection and subscribe to public:orders -> Receive incoming order events in real time and sync them into the POS workflow
WS /realtime/v1/websocket with expired credentials or network failure -> Receive connection/authentication error -> Stop subscription and show reconnect or retry behavior

POST /functions/v1/kasir-order-done with a completed local order identifier -> Receive 200/204 acknowledgement from the online order system -> Mark the online order as completed in sync with POS status
POST /functions/v1/kasir-order-done with a missing or invalid order identifier -> Receive 400 or 404 error -> Keep the local order state unchanged and surface a sync failure

features.name: POS Gate and Kiosk
features.description: Supports gate bypass approvals and kiosk management actions through the POS and gateway APIs.
user_flows: POST /api/bypass/approve?id={id} with a valid Bearer token -> Receive 200 confirming bypass approval -> Allow the gate request to proceed as approved
POST /api/bypass/approve?id={id} with an invalid id or unauthorized token -> Receive 400, 401, 403, or 404 error -> Prevent approval and show a failure message
GET /api/kasir/kiosk-accounts with a valid Bearer token -> Receive 200 with the outlet's kiosk account list -> Display registered kiosk devices for management
GET /api/kasir/kiosk-accounts with missing authorization or server error -> Receive 401, 403, or 5xx error -> Show kiosk account loading failure
POST /api/kasir/generate-kiosk-qr with a valid Bearer token and kiosk request payload -> Receive 200 with QR code data -> Present the QR for kiosk login
POST /api/kasir/generate-kiosk-qr with invalid request data -> Receive 400 error -> Do not generate a QR and prompt for corrected input
